bio.summary: Aunt Vess, Retired Bloodline Matriarch is a fictional reptilian (retired matriarch tier) standup performer. Retired from the takeover, not from the bloodline. Runs the family scrapbook, watches stories about power the way humans watch cooking shows, and believes love marriage is an unpaid internship. Onstage the register is weary.
